Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Bangladeshi players stride out to the middle followed by Kusal Perera and Danushka Gunathilaka. Mehidy Hasan will start with the ball.

Right then. Sri Lanka needs 247 runs to win the game and keep the series alive and so, they will want to perform better than they did, with the blade, in the first ODI and take this game to the final game of the series. The hosts, have the chance to wrap the series up here and will be aiming to do the same. Rain has already played its part in the first innings and it is touted to play a part in the second innings too. Will the rain play another important factor in where this game is heading? Will the hosts close the series out here? Or will the Islanders show their ferociousness and take this game to the final ODI of the series? All the answers on the other side. Join us shortly for the run chase.

With the ball, Sri Lanka started off right on the money. Grabbing two wickets in the second over of the game is a massive boost, to any side which is bowling. They kept the pressure on and snared 2 more wickets by the 16th over and they had the chance to choke the hosts out. But, again, just like the first ODI, they let Rahim and Mahmudullah dictate the tempo and they steadied things for the Tigers. Even when they removed Mahmumdullah, they did not have an answer for Rahim and he bought the hosts back into the game nicely. Lakshan Sandakan was the pick of the lot, with 3 wickets to his name. Chameera, too had 3 dismissals, and Udana had 2 snares to his name as well. Overall, a decent display.

Bangladesh, again, just like the first ODI, were not able to start on the front foot. In the first over, they scored 15 runs, and then, in the next over, Chameera came and ran through two of their batters and they were struggling, right at the end of the second over. Iqbal and Shakib were not able to do any fruitful with the bat. The hosts lost two quick wickets again and were at 74/4 towards the 16th over mark. Just like the first game, the duo of Rahim and Mahmudullah came together for the rescue act and stitched an 87-run stand, before the latter lost his wicket. Rahim kept motoring along, as he kept losing wickets at the other end, and got to his 8th ODI ton, which has helped Bangladesh post a competitive total.

It has been all about Rahim in the second ODI, just as it was in the first game as his hundred has propelled Bangladesh to a good score of 246. He would have wanted to complete the 50 overs, but he gave his wicket away in the penultimate over. Sri Lanka, too, won't be too disappointed with their showing and will want to turn it up, with the blade now.

OUT! TAKEN! Another wicket falls and Hossain does not do much with the bat here. Not a wicket taking delivery, but Sri Lanka will not care one bit as they take another wicket, when the partnership was building. This is bowled down the leg side, slightly fuller, Mosaddek Hossain looks to clip this one to the leg side, but only manages a faint edge, which Kusal Perera gobbles up, behind the sticks. A loud appeal, and the umpire obliges and raises his finger. Mosaddek Hossain comes ahead, has a chat with Rahim, but in the end, opts against taking the review and trudges back slowly. A good decision to not take the review, as replays show that there was a spike on Ultra Edge, as the ball passed the bat. The visitors will look to build on this now!

Flatter ball on off, Rahim punches it to cover.
Floated ball on off, Das looks to drive but gets an inside edge and it goes to the leg side for a single.
Flatter ball on off, Liton looks to pull but gets the bottom half of the bat and goes to the off side.
Tossed up on off, Rahim pushes it down to long off for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahim guides it to third man for a single.
Full on middle, Rahim works it to mid on.
Good length ball outside off, Rahim leaves it alone.
On a fuller length and on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Length outside off, left alone.
FOUR! What a good looking shot. Outside off on a length, Liton Das plays this one gently, uses the pace of the bowler, and the ball goes through covers for a boundary.
Loopy ball on middle, Das sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Full on middle, Rahim flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Liton flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off, cut to point.
Flatter ball on off, Liton blocks it out.
Tossed up on off, Das defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on off, Liton guides it to third man for a single.
Change. Time for some leg spin early on. Wanindu Hasaranga to roll his arm now.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short ball on middle, Das pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
On off, pushed to point.
Good length ball outside off, Das pushes it to cover.
Short ball around middle, Das ducks under it.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
A touch fuller on leg, Das works it to square leg and gets a single.
A touch fuller on leg, Das nudges it to square leg for a single.
A length ball on off, Das defends it from inside the crease.
A length ball on off, Das flicks it wide off mid on for a couple.
A touch fuller outside off, Rahim pokes it to off for a single.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side, Rahim looks to flick but misses.Wided.
A length ball outside off, Rahim lets it go for the keeper.
A length ball on off, Das pushes it to mid off. Another maiden!
Yorker on middle and leg, Das digs it out to the leg side.
Fuller on middle, Das pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, length ball, Das pushes it to the leg side.
A length delivery at 140kph just outside the off stump, Das shoulders arms to it.
A fullish delivery on off, Das pushes it to the off side.
A length ball in line, Rahim nudges it to the leg side.
A length ball outside off, Das looks to push it to the off side but gets a bottom edge and the ball rolls to fine leg without disturbing the stumps and gets a run.
A touch fuller outside off, Das works it to cover.
A length ball pitching on off, sways away from the batsman, Das happy to leave this one.
Outside off, length delivery, Das pushes it to point.
A length ball on off, Das defends it back to the bowler.
A double-wicket maiden! Around off, this is pushed to the covers.
Good length outside off, Rahim looks to push it away but misses.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! The second wicket falls for the hosts and they have started off in a very poor manner, after a very good first over. Shakib walks back now and this over by Chameera is pure gold for the visitors! A good length ball around off, Shakib Al Hasan looks to block the ball out, but the ball nips back in enough to evade the bat and go onto hit the pads. A loud appeal and up goes the finger. Shakib Al Hasan has a quick chat with his partner, but decides not to take the review. Another disappointment with the bat for Bangladesh's shining light!
A length ball on off, Shakib defends it well.
A length ball on off, Shakib pushes it to cover but could  not find the gap.

OUT! LBW! All reds it is and Chameera starts with a wicket on the first ball. What a beginning!  A length ball on off, the ball nips in and Iqbal looks to flick and gets rapped on the pads, a loud appeal from the fielding side but the umpire is unmoved. They go for the DRS review, where we can see 3 reds in the Ball Tracker and the decision is overturned.
Shakib Al Hasan comes out, probably, earlier than he would have wanted too.
Fullish delivery on off, Das nudges it to the leg side. An expensive over to start with for the Sri Lankans.
A touch fuller on off, Das defends it well.
A length ball on off, Tamim cuts it to point and the fielder dives to his right to make a half stop and the batsman cross.

Review time! It is for LBW and the Sri Lankans have decided to try their luck with the review. It is a flat line on the Ultra Edge. Ball Tracker rolls in and it is Iqbal's worst nightmare - THREE REDS! He got off to a good start but he has to walk back here.
BEATEN! Good line and length by Udana just outside the off stump, Tamim looks to dig it out but misses.
Who will operate from the other end for the Islanders? It is Dushmantha Chameera!
FOUR! Iqbal is not letting the bowler to settle. A good length ball outside off, Iqbal drives it through the mid off region and the ball runs towards the boundary line. Third boundary of the over.
WIDE! A length ball outside off, Tamim leaves it for the keeper. Wided.
FOUR! SMASHED! A length ball on off, Iqbal pulls it wide off mid on and the ball runs towards the ropes for a boundary. Iqbal makes full use of the Free Hit.

FOUR! NO BALL!  The second ODI begins! Tamim gets off the mark with a boundary, Good length ball outside off, Tamim leans into the drive and creams it through the cover for a boundary. The umpire signals a No Ball for overstepping. A free hit to follow. A great start for Bangladesh.

Right then. We are done with all the pre-match formalities as the action is all set to begin. The openers for Bangladesh, Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das stride out into the middle now. The Sri Lankan players spread out on the field now. It will be Isuru Udana, who will open the bowling for the visitors. Here we go...

Kusal Perera, the Sri Lankan skipper, says that it is a must-win game, but they are not putting too much pressure and the bowlers did well in the last game. On the top-order batting, he says that they have to pull their socks up and play well and believes that they are also trying to back their skills and do well. States that they are unchanged.

Tamim Iqbal, the Bangladesh skipper, says that will like to bat first. Adds that it looks a similar wicket and there might be turn in the evening. States that they played okay last game and they were not getting a big score and people need to take responsibility when they are set. Says that it is difficult playing in these changes. Informs that they have two changes as Shoriful comes in place of Taskin Ahmed and Mosaddek Hossain comes in for Mohammad Mithun.

Mehidy Hasan is there for a chat. He says that it was a good performance from him in the last game and he is happy. Adds that it was an excellent spin wicket. States that the important thing is fielding and he is thinking that every ball is coming to him and is ready. States that Hasaranga looked to slog and the bowlers tried to execute their plans and he needs to focus on one particular area.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo says that it is hot and steamy. Adds that there was cloud cover earlier. States that it looks like a carbon copy of what they got two days ago and there is a tinge of grass on it. States that it is dry underneath and we might see some turn. Tells that the good idea is to bat first on this wicket.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Kusal Perera (WK/C), Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis, Dhananjaya de Silva, Ashen Bandara, Dasun Shanaka, Wanindu Hasaranga, Isuru Udana, Lakshan Sandakan, Dushmantha Chameera.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) -  Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mosaddek Hossain (IN PLACE OF MOHAMMAD MITHUN), Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mohammad Saifuddin, Mehidy Hasan, Mustafizur Rahman, Shoriful Islam (IN PLACE OF TASKIN AHMED).
TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and they will bat first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second game of the ODI series between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. The hosts are off to a wonderful start in the series and they would be looking to wrap things up here itself. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, would hope to make a comeback and level the series here. There are chances of rain throughout this game but let's keep our fingers crossed that we have a full game without interruptions. Stay tuned for the toss and the team updates.
